prometheus.comment: Exact Prometheus 0.0.4 exposition outputs. The TS registry must render byte-identical text for identical family/record shapes (minus the wlct_registry_series_overflow_total preamble, which each side renders from its own counter).

vectors.name: counter-single-label
vectors.text:
# HELP wlct_registry_series_overflow_total New label sets refused by the per-family series cap.
# TYPE wlct_registry_series_overflow_total counter
wlct_registry_series_overflow_total{service="engine"} 0
# HELP wlct_risk_decisions_total Risk decisions evaluated, by verdict.
# TYPE wlct_risk_decisions_total counter
wlct_risk_decisions_total{result="approved",service="engine"} 3
wlct_risk_decisions_total{result="rejected",service="engine"} 1

readiness.comment: Gate order: market_data,risk_engine,risk_state_fresh,exchange_connectivity,execution_adapter,reconciliation,queues,kill_switches,configuration. Row semantics are the TS evaluator's contract: missing evidence blocks, stale blocks, and only all-satisfied yields ready=true.

redaction.comment: redact_value / is_sensitive_key answers. 'expected' is computed by the reference implementation; 'declared' appears only where the generator also had a human-written expectation, and the TS suite asserts BOTH 'expected' and every 'forbidden' substring being absent from its own output.
